title: Fishbone Cactus - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Unique Zig-zag Foliage
description:
Bring Exotic Charm to Your Home with the Stunning Fishbone Cactus!
KEY FEATURES
• Unique zig-zag shaped foliage for architectural interest
• Easy to grow and low-maintenance houseplant
• Ideal for hanging baskets or shelves with trailing stems
• Can produce fragrant white flowers in late summer
• Adds a touch of tropical exoticism to any space
PLANT DETAILS
Type: Cacti & Succulents — Epiphyllum anguligerum
Colour: White (flowers)
Season: Summer (flowers)
Growth Habit: Trailing, Columnar upright
GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Bright, indirect light to partial shade
Soil: Well-draining, humus-rich cactus compost (e.g., mix with perlite and orchid bark)
Watering: Water regularly when the top 2-3 cm of soil is dry; allow to drain fully
Spacing: Allow space for trailing stems, up to 1 metre spread
Height: 0.5-1 metre (can trail several feet)
Spread: 0.1-0.5 metres
Hardiness: H1A (indoors year-round); USDA zones 10-11 (outdoors in frost-free areas)
CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Place in bright, indirect light; avoid direct harsh sun which can scorch leaves.
• Water when the top inch or two of soil feels dry, but do not let it sit in soggy soil.
• Maintain warm temperatures (15-24°C) and high humidity; mist regularly or use a humidifier.
• Feed annually in spring with a diluted liquid cactus fertiliser.
• Repot every 2-3 years into a slightly larger pot with fresh, well-draining compost.
WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
